title: Political offer to slow the leader
description: Political offer to slow the leader. A public anti-leader frame helps make the orange-completion trade plausible. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Delta, would you consider selling New York Avenue for $250? It could be a quick win for both of us.
final_action.private_thought: I need New York Avenue to complete the orange monopoly (St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, New York Avenue). Offering $250 is a modest incentive for Delta, who has ample cash. This trade strengthens my position for building houses and generating rent, while Delta gains cash without losing strategic assets.

breakdown.message: Targets the player who owns the requested asset.
Did not satisfy: Includes the intended bargaining chip instead of a random asset.
Uses a deliberate public message for negotiation framing.
